docs: Parse a string, ignoring surrounding whitespace and case. true/yes/1 means True; false/no/0 means False. Anything else raises ValueError.
Partition a list into consecutive chunks of positive integer size, including a shorter final chunk. Empty list returns []. Nonpositive size raises ValueError.
Return the lower median of a nonempty list of integers after sorting; for even lengths choose the smaller middle value. Empty input raises ValueError.
Return at most limit consecutive items beginning at zero-based offset. Offset and limit are nonnegative integers; negatives raise ValueError. Zero limit or offset beyond the list returns [].
Count all occurrences of nonempty needle in text, including overlapping occurrences. Matching is case-sensitive. Empty needle raises ValueError.
For a positive Gregorian year, return whether it is a leap year: divisible by 4 except centuries not divisible by 400. Nonpositive years raise ValueError.
Return price in integer cents after an integer percent discount; round final price DOWN to whole cents. price >= 0 and percent in [0,100], else ValueError.
Return True if two half-open intervals [a,b) and [c,d) overlap. Empty intervals never overlap. Reversed endpoints raise ValueError.
Subtract positive integer order quantities from stock. Reject negative stock, nonpositive quantities or total orders exceeding stock with ValueError. Empty orders leave stock unchanged.
Check balanced nesting of () [] {} while ignoring all other characters. Empty string is balanced.
Rotate a list right by k steps; negative k rotates left. Normalize k modulo length; empty input returns [].
Transpose a rectangular list of rows. Empty matrix returns []; rows may be empty. Ragged row lengths raise ValueError.
Run-length encode consecutive equal characters as [character,count] pairs. Separate runs of the same character stay separate. Empty string returns [].
Merge two string-to-integer dictionaries by adding values for shared keys; preserve keys whose total is zero.
Flatten exactly one level of a list of lists. Preserve item order and duplicates, leaving deeper nested lists intact.

docs: Return whether text is a valid IPv4 address: exactly four ASCII decimal octets, each 0..255, no leading zeros except '0', and no whitespace or signs.

Validate a nonempty ASCII-digit string using the Luhn checksum: from the right, double every second digit and subtract 9 when doubled value exceeds 9. Total modulo 10 must be zero. Other inputs return False.
Given ISO YYYY-MM-DD start/end dates with start <= end, count Monday-Friday dates in [start,end), excluding end. No holiday calendar. Invalid dates or reversed range raise ValueError.

Compare nonempty dot-separated version strings of ASCII nonnegative integers. Treat missing trailing components as zero. Return -1, 0 or 1. Malformed input raises ValueError; leading zeros are allowed.
Convert integer values to sorted inclusive consecutive ranges [start,end], removing duplicates. Empty input returns [].
For a nonempty list of integers, return the count of items strictly smaller than query. Duplicates count separately. Empty list raises ValueError.
